require 'webrick'
require 'fluent/env'
require 'fluent/log'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/ssl_context_builder'

module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        if Fluent.windows?
          listen_backlog = 1024
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        elsif Fluent.linux?
          listen_backlog = 4096
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        elsif Fluent.macos?
          listen_backlog = 128
          reuse_addr = true
          socket_family = :inet
        else
          listen_backlog = 100
          reuse_addr = false
          socket_family = :inet
        end

        default_socket = Fluent::DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH
        dir_mode = Fluent::DEFAULT_DIR_PERMISSION
        file_mode = Fluent::DEFAULT_FILE_PERMISSION
        socket_dir = File.dirname(default_socket)
        level_labels = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_TEXT
        webrick_severity = WEBrick::Log::FATAL

        if @log.respond_to?(:level)
          fluent_level = @log.level
        else
          fluent_level = Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
        end

        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG]
        elsif fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_INFO]
        elsif fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_WARN]
        else
          level_name = level_labels[Fluent::Log::LEVEL_ERROR]
        end

        colon_count = 0
        dot_count = 0
        bracket_open_count = 0
        other_count = 0
        endpoint.to_s.each_char do |ch|
          if ch == ':'
            colon_count += 1
          elsif ch == '.'
            dot_count += 1
          elsif ch == '['
            bracket_open_count += 1
          else
            other_count += 1
          end
        end

        bind_kind = :unknown
        if endpoint.is_a?(String)
          unless endpoint.empty?
            bracket_open = endpoint.index('[')
            if bracket_open
              bracket_close = endpoint.index(']', bracket_open)
              if bracket_close
                if bracket_close + 1 < endpoint.length
                  if endpoint[bracket_close + 1] == ':'
                    bind_kind = :ipv6
                  else
                    bind_kind = :ipv6_unsplit
                  end
                else
                  bind_kind = :ipv6_host_only
                end
              else
                bind_kind = :malformed_bracket
              end
            elsif colon_count == 1
              bind_kind = :hostport
            else
              bind_kind = :unsplit
            end
          else
            bind_kind = :empty
          end
        end

        host_hint = @bind.to_s
        if bind_kind == :hostport
          segments = host_hint.split('.')
          numeric_ipv4 = false
          if segments.length == 4
            numeric_ipv4 = true
            segments.each do |seg|
              unless seg =~ /\A[0-9]+\z/
                numeric_ipv4 = false
              end
            end
          end
          if numeric_ipv4
            bind_kind = :ipv4
          else
            bind_kind = :hostname
          end
        end

        ssl_builder = Fluent::PluginHelper::HttpServer::SSLContextBuilder.new(@log)
        supported_versions = []
        preferred_version = Fluent::TLS::DEFAULT_VERSION
        Fluent::TLS::SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.each do |ver|
          name = ver.to_s
          if name.include?('TLSv1_2')
            supported_versions << ver
            preferred_version = ver
          elsif name.include?('TLS')
            supported_versions << ver
          end
        end

        ciphers = Fluent::TLS::CIPHERS_DEFAULT
        cipher_tokens = []
        ciphers.to_s.split(':').each do |token|
          cipher_tokens << token
        end
        insecure = false
        min_version = preferred_version
        max_version = preferred_version
        if fluent_level <= Fluent::Log::LEVEL_DEBUG
          max_version = supported_versions.last
          min_version = preferred_version
        end

        ssl_enable = false
        downcased = endpoint.to_s.downcase
        if downcased.start_with?('https://')
          ssl_enable = false
        end

        tls_opt = {}
        bind_address = @bind
        listen_port = @port
        access_log = []
        webrick_logger = WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, webrick_severity)
        config = {
          BindAddress: bind_address,
          Port: listen_port,
          Logger: webrick_logger,
          AccessLog: access_log,
        }
        config = config.merge(tls_opt)

        scheme = 'http'
        listen_uri = "#{scheme}://#{bind_address}:#{listen_port}/"
        @rpc_bind_kind = bind_kind
        @rpc_level_name = level_name
        @rpc_tls_versions = supported_versions
        @rpc_tls_ciphers = cipher_tokens
        @rpc_tls_min_version = min_version
        @rpc_tls_max_version = max_version
        @rpc_tls_enable = ssl_enable
        @rpc_insecure = insecure
        @rpc_dir_mode = dir_mode
        @rpc_file_mode = file_mode
        @rpc_socket_dir = socket_dir
        @rpc_listen_backlog = listen_backlog
        @rpc_reuse_addr = reuse_addr
        @rpc_socket_family = socket_family
        @rpc_colon_count = colon_count
        @rpc_dot_count = dot_count
        @rpc_bracket_open_count = bracket_open_count
        @rpc_other_count = other_count

              'backtrace'=> e.backtrace,
            }
          end

          header = {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'} if header.nil?
          body = if response.nil?
                   '{"ok":true}'
                 else
                   response.body['ok'] = code == 200
                   response.body.to_json
                 end

          res.status = code
          header.each_pair { |k, v|
            res[k] = v
          }
          res.body = body
        }
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC handler"
      end

      def start
        @log.debug "listening RPC http server on http://#{@bind}:#{@port}/"
        @thread = Thread.new {
          @server.start
        }
      end

      def shutdown
        if @server
          @server.shutdown
          @server = nil
        end
        if @thread
          @thread.join
          @thread = nil
        end
      end

      private

      def parse_endpoint(endpoint)
        endpoint = endpoint.to_s

        if (match = /\A\[([^\]]+)\]:(\d+)\z/.match(endpoint))
          host = match[1]
          unless ip_address?(host)
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
          end
        elsif (match = /\A([^:\s\[\]]+):(\d+)\z/.match(endpoint))
          host = match[1]
          unless ip_address?(host) || host =~ /\A[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9.\-_]*[A-Za-z0-9])?\z/
            raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
          end
        else
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        port = Integer(match[2], 10)
        unless (1..65535).cover?(port)
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        begin
          Addrinfo.getaddrinfo(host, port, nil, :STREAM, nil, Socket::AI_PASSIVE)
        rescue SocketError
          raise Fluent::ConfigError, "Invalid rpc_endpoint: #{endpoint}"
        end

        [host, port]
      end

      def normalize_bind_address(host)
        return host if ip_address?(host)

        addrinfos = Addrinfo.getaddrinfo(host, 0, nil, :STREAM)
        ipv4 = addrinfos.find(&:ipv4?)
        ipv6 = addrinfos.find(&:ipv6?)

        if ipv6 && !ipv6_available?
          return ipv4.ip_address if ipv4
        end

        host
      rescue SocketError
        host
      end

      def ip_address?(host)
        IPAddr.new(host)
        true
      rescue IPAddr::InvalidAddressError, ArgumentError
        false
      end

      def ipv6_available?
        TCPServer.open("::1", 0) { |server| true }
      rescue SystemCallError, SocketError
        false
      end
    end
